title: tk herd paint + event hooks: worker workspace metadata badges
description: New small command tk herd paint (cobra+legacy switch+ResetFlags; ExitError) that reads manifests + tk state and calls pane.report_metadata/workspace.report_metadata via the socket client: workspace title "<tick-id> - <role> - wave", state labels, TTL token badges (parked until data exists: tests/diff-size). Plugin event hooks (herdr-plugin.toml events section) run it on pane.agent_status_changed etc. Respect TTLs so stale badges expire. Live-verify report_metadata field shapes against herdr api schema first (methods exist: workspace.report_metadata, pane.report_metadata; CLI pane report-metadata shows the field vocabulary).
acceptance_criteria: Live: a herd-spawned worker workspace shows tick-id title + state label painted by the hook; badges TTL-expire; unit tests against herdtest for the paint logic
